# Montessori Minds (La Casa Verde by Montessori Minds)
> Montessori school, nursery and pre-school in Choueifat, Lebanon for children from infancy through age six.

Montessori Minds operates La Casa Verde on Saida Old Road, Al Omara District, Choueifat. We offer Montessori Infant Community (Nido), Toddler Community, and Children's House (ages 3–6). Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM. Phone: +961 71 007 150. Email: hello@montessorimindslb.com.

## Programs
- Infant Community (Nido): birth–18 months — https://www.montessorimindslb.com/nursery
- Toddler Community: 18 months–3 years — https://www.montessorimindslb.com/nursery
- Children's House: 3–6 years — https://www.montessorimindslb.com/preschool
- All programs overview — https://www.montessorimindslb.com/programs
